India Rejects Pakistan's Claims, Denies Involvement in Track-2 Dialogue

India's Ministry of External Affairs has rejected allegations from Pakistan linking New Delhi to a militant attack in Karachi. Simultaneously, Indian officials, including Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri, have distanced the government from reports of a Track-2 dialogue with Pakistan, stating these are private initiatives that hold no official value. This comes amidst ongoing tensions and differing narratives between the two nations.
